title: Document comments: confirm the decisions made in notes and chat

steps.headline: Word and Excel files keep their comments inside the file; every other file keeps them in a hidden folder in the project.
steps.changed: From your note on the first page: files that can hold comments natively store them there.
steps.notice: Open the file in Word, Excel or Google Docs and your comments are there too.

steps.headline: Spreadsheet comments are in this version: attached to cells and saved into the spreadsheet file.
steps.notice: Excel shows the same cell comments you left in YouCoded.

steps.headline: Word comments work both ways in this version: comments from Word or Google Docs show here, and yours show there.
steps.changed: From your answer on the first page. It may be built in stages but merges as one piece of work.
steps.notice: You can reply in YouCoded to a colleague's Word comment and they see your reply in Word.

steps.headline: Google Docs support means the Word file keeps its comments when opened there; a live Google Drive link comes later.
steps.changed: You said "just file itself for now" in chat.
steps.notice: Uploading a commented Word file to Google Drive keeps the comments.

steps.headline: The assistant leaves comments sparingly: only on things that clearly need your action or attention, never to narrate its own work.
steps.changed: From your note on the first page.
steps.notice: A document the assistant edits does not fill up with its notes.

steps.path: After the assistant edits commented text
steps.headline: After fixing a comment, the assistant decides whether to reply, resolve, or move it to the new wording; nothing is silently lost.
steps.changed: You said "up to the assistant, depending on situation" in chat.
steps.notice: A comment whose text disappeared and wasn't resolved stays in the list marked "text no longer found".

steps.headline: Ask Your Assistant sends one summary chip ("2 comments · file.md") instead of one chip per comment.
steps.changed: Built after your review note. Hovering the chip lights up every highlight it covers; clicking opens the comment panel.
steps.notice: The sent message stays one short line however many comments you left.

steps.path: Projects → a file → Comments → Ask Your Assistant
steps.headline: From the Projects screen, Ask Your Assistant opens the new-chat pop-up with the file's project chosen and a model to pick.
steps.changed: Built after your review answer, using the same pop-up as Create a page.
steps.notice: The request is waiting in the new chat's typing box; you press send.
